lines.cap: Every July, America's most powerful old men go deep into the woods, put on robes, and play with fire. Wives not invited.
lines.say: Every July, America's most powerful old men go deep into the woods, put on robes, and play with fire. Wives not invited.

lines.cap: It's called Bohemian Grove. A private camp in the California redwoods.
lines.say: It's called Bohemian Grove. A private camp in the California redwoods.

lines.cap: Presidents, bankers, billionaires. The biggest wallets in America, all in one tent.
lines.say: Presidents, bankers, billionaires. The biggest wallets in America, all in one tent.

lines.cap: Rule one. No women. The most expensive sausage party on Earth. Rule two. No business. Their motto is, weaving spiders come not here. Funny, because the guest list is mostly spiders.
lines.say: Rule one. No women. The most expensive sausage party on Earth. Rule two. No business. Their motto is, weaving spiders come not here. Funny, because the guest list is mostly spiders.

lines.cap: Relax. It's a dummy. It stands for their worries. Which, when you're that rich, is mostly taxes.

lines.cap: But here's the dark part. In nineteen forty two, scientists met at the Grove, to plan the atomic bomb.

lines.cap: Send this to the one friend who'd definitely get invited. Because while you're stuck at work, they're in the woods, burning their cares away, and deciding yours. Because every July,
